experiment: Stage 1 retrieval improvement via v3 multi-vector index
approach: Multi-vector index (description + intent-oriented trigger phrases) + new phrases for 13 missed skills

v3_config.phrases_per_skill: 4 existing + 6 new intent-oriented for 13 missed skills; 4 elsewhere

v3_final_test.CONTAMINATION_WARNING: 13 skills were selected from final_test MISS_STAGE1 failures; phrases were tuned to those exact prompts; measuring on the same set is circular — these numbers are inflated

v3_clean_test.note: Independent sample (seed=99, prompt-id-prefix=ct); no overlap with final_test or dev; all set_size=1

baseline_clean_test.note: Single-vector baseline (skills_index.npz, v1 phrases) on same 120-prompt clean_test — matched comparison

matched_comparison.verdict: CIs fully overlap. The entire 15.3pp gain on contaminated final_test was test-set fitting. The v3 intent-oriented phrases do not generalize beyond the specific prompts they were tuned to.

honest_three_number_report.final_test_contaminated: 85.5% (106/124) — CONTAMINATED: 13 skills selected from its own MISS_STAGE1 failures
honest_three_number_report.development_unchanged: 63.6% (140/220) — phrases not fitted to dev failures; unchanged dev score exposed the contamination
honest_three_number_report.clean_test_real: 75.8% (91/120) — independent sample, seed=99; matched baseline is 75.0% (+0.8pp, not significant)
honest_three_number_report.verdict: The gain was entirely fitting. v3 phrases provide no detectable improvement on unseen data. Baseline stands.

dev_set_comparison.rationale: K=20+ all equivalent on dev set; K=40 preserves original design

success_criteria_on_clean_test.miss_stage1_lt_10: NOT ACHIEVED on clean test (20); was 7 on contaminated final_test
success_criteria_on_clean_test.exact_ge_80pct: NOT ACHIEVED on clean test (75.8%); was 85.5% on contaminated final_test

next_steps.recommendation: Baseline config is the honest current state. v3 phrases do not improve unseen accuracy. Next levers: (1) implied-need routing — 34pp gap (50% vs 84.4%) is the largest open problem; (2) overrouting — 29 false-positive failures need description disambiguation or hierarchical routing.
next_steps.implied_exact_gap: 50.0% implied vs 84.4% explicit on clean_test — this is the single largest remaining gap
